authenticatedTools.name: list_locations
authenticatedTools.title: List connected locations
authenticatedTools.description: List every location connected to this business across its review platforms (Google Business Profile, TripAdvisor).

businessId.description: OAuth only: which of your businesses to act on. Omit it and, if you manage more than one, the call returns a business picker instead of doing the work: a SUCCESS result whose payload is { businesses: [...], hint: "..." }. Call again with businessId set to one of the returned businessId values. Ignored when authenticating with a per-business token, where the token pins the business.

authenticatedTools.name: list_unanswered_reviews
authenticatedTools.title: List unanswered reviews
authenticatedTools.description: List reviews awaiting a reply for this business across all connected platforms (Google and TripAdvisor), optionally scoped to one location. Each review includes its provider.

businessId.description: OAuth only: which of your businesses to act on. Omit it and, if you manage more than one, the call returns a business picker instead of doing the work: a SUCCESS result whose payload is { businesses: [...], hint: "..." }. Call again with businessId set to one of the returned businessId values. Ignored when authenticating with a per-business token, where the token pins the business.

locationId.description: Optional location id to scope the list to.

authenticatedTools.name: get_review_context
authenticatedTools.title: Get review context
authenticatedTools.description: Get full context for a single review: text, business, language, provider (google or tripadvisor), and every drafted reply variant.

authenticatedTools.name: draft_reply
authenticatedTools.title: Draft AI reply variants
authenticatedTools.description: Generate AI reply variants for a pending review (Google or TripAdvisor) and save them as drafts awaiting human approval.

reviewId.description: The pending review id to draft a reply for.

authenticatedTools.name: submit_reply_for_approval
authenticatedTools.title: Submit a drafted reply for approval
authenticatedTools.description: Commit one of StarReview's drafted variants (from `draft_reply`) into the owner's approval queue, optionally editing its text. For Google, an unedited reply on a consented, positive review may be scheduled and StarReview posts it from its own infrastructure. For TripAdvisor (no reply API), an approved reply comes back as `awaitingManualPost` with a `platformListingUrl` deep-link the owner posts through in TripAdvisor's own portal; StarReview never posts to TripAdvisor. To submit the agent's OWN reply text instead (no prior draft), use `submit_own_reply`.

reviewId.description: The review id the reply is being submitted for.

variant.description: Which drafted variant number (from draft_reply) to submit. Required.

finalText.description: Optional: overrides the chosen draft variant's text with this edited version.

preferredPostAt.description: Optional ISO 8601 timestamp: StarReview will not post the reply before this time. StarReview's own scheduler/poster still performs the actual publish.

authenticatedTools.name: submit_own_reply
authenticatedTools.title: Submit your own reply for approval
authenticatedTools.description: Submit the agent's OWN reply text into the owner's approval queue, with no StarReview draft (no LLM call). Always requires human approval and NEVER auto-schedules — even on a positive, consented business. StarReview publishes every reply from its own infrastructure after the owner approves; the agent only drafts and submits. To commit one of StarReview's own drafts instead, use `submit_reply_for_approval`.

reviewId.description: The review id the reply is being submitted for.

finalText.description: The agent's own reply text. This IS the reply. Required.

preferredPostAt.description: Optional ISO 8601 timestamp: StarReview will not post the reply before this time. StarReview's own scheduler/poster still performs the actual publish.

publicTools.name: get_service_info
publicTools.title: About StarReview
publicTools.description: What StarReview does, pricing (CHF 0.50 per published reply, drafting is free), how a business signs up, and how an agent authenticates via OAuth.

publicTools.name: search_business
publicTools.title: Find a business on Google Maps
publicTools.description: Find a business on Google Maps by name, optionally with its city. Returns up to 5 candidates; feed the chosen candidate's placeId to check_response_rate.

query.description: Business name, optionally with city, e.g. "Restaurant Adler Zuerich".

publicTools.name: check_response_rate
publicTools.title: Check review response rate
publicTools.description: Free check: what share of this business's recent Google reviews received an owner reply, benchmarked against up to two nearby competitors. placeId must come from a recent search_business call. Results are cached for about 30 days; do not repeat the call for the same place.

lang.description: Optional locale for the check (default de).
